INSERT INTO INTERF_OPICS_TRAD_SECDEAL T (BR, DEALNO, SECID, COST, CCY, INVTYPE, PS, PRICE_8, YIELD_8, CNO, FACEAMT, PRINAMT, SETTAMT, PORT, PRODUCT, PRODTYPE, TRAD, CONVINTAMT, BROK, INPUTDATE, DEALDATE, SETTDATE, REVDATE, UPDATECOUNTER, FEDEALNO, DEALTEXT, LSTMNTDATE, EFFECTFLAG) VALUES (S.BR, S.DEALNO, concat('IB',IFNULL( TRIM(S.SECID),'')), S.COST, S.CCY, S.INVTYPE, S.PS, S.PRICE_8, S.YIELD_8, S.CNO, S.FACEAMT, S.PRINAMT, S.SETTAMT, S.PORT, S.PRODUCT, S.PRODTYPE, S.TRAD, S.CONVINTAMT, S.BROK, S.INPUTDATE, S.DEALDATE, S.SETTDATE, S.REVDATE, S.UPDATECOUNTER, S.FEDEALNO, S.DEALTEXT, S.VERDATE, #{EFFECTFLAG ,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
(SELECT A.BR as BR, A.DEALNO as DEALNO, A.SECID as SECID, A.COST as COST, A.CCY as CCY, A.INVTYPE as INVTYPE, A.PS as PS, A.PRICE_8 as PRICE_8, A.YIELD_8 as YIELD_8, A.CNO as CNO, A.FACEAMT as FACEAMT, A.PRINAMT as PRINAMT, A.SETTAMT as SETTAMT, A.PORT as PORT, A.PRODUCT as PRODUCT, A.PRODTYPE as PRODTYPE, A.TRAD as TRAD, A.CONVINTAMT as CONVINTAMT, A.BROK as BROK, A.INPUTDATE as INPUTDATE, A.DEALDATE as DEALDATE, A.SETTDATE as SETTDATE, A.REVDATE as REVDATE, A.UPDATECOUNTER as UPDATECOUNTER, A.FEDEALNO as FEDEALNO, A.DEALTEXT as DEALTEXT, A.VERDATE as VERDATE FROM SDB_V_SPSH@OPICS A WHERE A.VERDATE = #{cDate ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRIM(A.BR) = '06' AND TRIM(A.COST) IN (SELECT BD.CODE FROM OPICS_COST_PORTFOLIO BD WHERE BD.EFFECTFLAG = #{EFFECTFLAG ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND A.PORT <> 'MMRM') S ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET T.BR=S.BR, T.SECID=concat（'IB',IFNULL( TRIM(S.SECID),'')), T.COST=S.COST, T.CCY=S.CCY, T.INVTYPE=S.INVTYPE, T.PS=S.PS, T.PRICE_8=S.PRICE_8, T.YIELD_8=S.YIELD_8, T.CNO=S.CNO, T.FACEAMT=S.FACEAMT, T.PRINAMT=S.PRINAMT, T.SETTAMT=S.SETTAMT, T.PORT=S.PORT, T.PRODUCT=S.PRODUCT, T.PRODTYPE=S.PRODTYPE, T.TRAD=S.TRAD, T.CONVINTAMT=S.CONVINTAMT, T.BROK=S.BROK, T.INPUTDATE=S.INPUTDATE, T.DEALDATE=S.DEALDATE, T.SETTDATE=S.SETTDATE, T.REVDATE=S.REVDATE, T.UPDATECOUNTER=S.UPDATECOUNTER, T.FEDEALNO=S.FEDEALNO, T.DEALTEXT=S.DEALTEXT, T.LSTMNTDATE=S.VERDATE, T.EFFECTFLAG='E'

INSERT INTO INTERF_OPICS_TRAD_SECDEAL T (SELECT A.REVDATE as REVDATE, A.DEALNO as DEALNO FROM SDB_V_SPSH@OPICS A WHERE A.REVDATE = #{cDate ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRIM(A.BR) = '06' AND TRIM(A.COST) IN (SELECT BD.CODE FROM OPICS_COST_PORTFOLIO BD WHERE BD.EFFECTFLAG = #{EFFECTFLAG ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND A.PORT <> 'MMRM') S ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SET T.REVDATE = S.REVDATE;
